input: Install blackout curtains in the master bedroom

gold.taskTitle: Install Blackout Curtains in the Master Bedroom
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to install blackout curtains in their master bedroom.

questions.title: How many windows need blackout curtains installed?
questions.description: Determine the number of windows in the master bedroom that require curtains.

questions.title: Do you already own the curtains and hardware?
questions.description: Find out whether the user needs to purchase curtains, rods, or mounting hardware first.

questions.title: What type of curtain rod mount do you prefer?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants ceiling-mounted, wall-mounted above the frame, or inside-the-frame installation.

questions.title: Are the walls drywall, plaster, concrete, or other?
questions.description: Understand the wall material to determine the correct drill bits and anchors needed.

questions.title: Do you have the tools needed for the job?
questions.description: Check whether the user has a drill, level, measuring tape, and screwdrivers available.

questions.title: Will you do the installation yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Determine if this is a DIY project or if a handyman needs to be scheduled.

questions.title: What is your target date to have this completed?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe so the plan can be prioritized accordingly.
